CREATE TABLE ENVIO_MOVCI_SINDO_TMP TABLESPACE MG_TS_N_DATA_002_TRABAJO AS SELECT LPAD(CIC.CVE_ID_CORRECCION_CTA_IND_CDA,22,'0')||'CDA' AS FOLSOL, LPAD(CTAO.CVE_DELEGACION_ORIGEN, 2,'0') AS DELEGORIG, SUBSTR(CTAO.CVE_REGISTRO_PATRONAL, 1,8) AS REGPATORIG, CTAO.CVE_MODALIDAD AS MODPATORIG, CASE WHEN CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_OPER_ORIGEN = 'I' THEN 'A' ELSE CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_OPER_ORIGEN END AS TIPOOPORIG, --CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_CORRECCION AS TIPOOPORIG, SUBSTR(CTAO.NSS,1,10) AS NSSORIG, SUBSTR(CTAO.NSS,11,1) AS DVNSSORIG, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_RECEPCION_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY') AS FERECMOVORIG, LPAD(CTAO.CVE_TIPO_INI_MOV, 2 ,'0') TIPMOVINIORIG, CTAO.CVE_INI_MOV AS ORIGMOVINIORIG, --'0' AS ORIGMOVINIORIG, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_INI_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY') FECMOVINIORIG, LPAD(TRIM(replace( to_char(CTAO.SALARIO_BASE, '999999D99'), '.', '')),6, '0') AS SALBASEORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_TIPO_SALARIO), '0') as TIPOSALORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_EVENTUAL),0) AS TIPOTRABORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_EXT_CONV_SUSP),0) AS EXTEMPORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_SUBR_SERVICIOS),0) AS SUBROGSERVORIG, LPAD(CTAO.CVE_TIPO_FIN_MOV, 2, '0') AS TIPOMOVFINORIG, CTAO.CVE_FIN_MOV AS ORIGMOVFINORIG, --'0' AS ORIGMOVFINORIG, CASE WHEN NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_FIN_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY'), '00000000') = '31129999' THEN '00000000' ELSE NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_FIN_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY'), '00000000') END AS FEMOVFINORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_JORNADA_SEMANAL),0) JORSEMORIG, CASE WHEN LPAD(CTAO.CVE_CONSEC_PERIODOS, 3, '0') is null THEN '000' else LPAD(CTAO.CVE_CONSEC_PERIODOS, 3, '0') end NUMCONSPERORIG, --LPAD(CTAO.CVE_CONSEC_PERIODOS, 3, '0') NUMCONSPERORIG, NVL(CTAO.CURP,' ') AS CURPORIG, SUBSTR(CTAD.CVE_REGISTRO_PATRONAL,1,8) AS REGPATDEST, CTAD.CVE_MODALIDAD AS MODPATDEST, -- CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_CORRECCION AS TIPOOPERDEST, CASE WHEN CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_OPER_DESTINO = 'I' THEN 'A' ELSE CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_OPER_DESTINO END AS TIPOOPERDEST, SUBSTR(CTAD.NSS,1,10) NSSDEST, SUBSTR(CTAD.NSS,11,1) DVNSSDEST, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAD.FEC_RECEPCION_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY') AS FECRECEPMOVDEST, LPAD(CTAD.CVE_TIPO_INI_MOV,2,0) AS TIPOMOVDEST, --0' AS ORIMOVINIDEST, CTAD.CVE_INI_MOV AS ORIMOVINIDEST, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAD.FEC_INI_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY') AS FECMOVINIDEST, LPAD(TRIM(replace( to_char(CTAD.SALARIO_BASE, '999999D99'), '.', '')),6, '0') AS SALBASCOTDEST, NVL(TRIM(CTAD.CVE_TIPO_SALARIO), '0') AS TIPOSALDEST, NVL(TRIM(CTAD.CVE_EVENTUAL),0) AS TIPOTRABEVEDEST, NVL(TRIM(CTAD.CVE_EXT_CONV_SUSP),0) AS EXTEMPDEST, NVL(TRIM(CTAD.CVE_SUBR_SERVICIOS),0) AS SUBROGSERVDEST, LPAD(CTAD.CVE_TIPO_FIN_MOV, 2, '0') AS TIPOMOVFINDEST, --'0' AS ORIMOVFINDEST, CTAD.CVE_FIN_MOV AS ORIMOVFINDEST, --TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAD.FEC_FIN_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY') AS FECMOVFINDEST, CASE WHEN NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAD.FEC_FIN_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY'), '00000000') = '31129999' THEN '00000000' ELSE NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAD.FEC_FIN_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY'), '00000000') END AS FECMOVFINDEST, NVL(TRIM(CTAD.CVE_JORNADA_SEMANAL),0) AS JORNSEMDEST, LPAD(TO_CHAR(CIC.IND_CONSECUTIVO_MOVIMIENTO),3,'0') AS NUMPERCONSECDEST, NVL(CTAD.CURP,' ') CURPORIG2, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DDMMYYYY') AS FECENVIO, LPAD(' ', 50, ' ') AS FILLER ,CIC.CVE_ID_CORRECCION_CTA_IND_CDA AS IDTRAMITE ,DELE.CVE_CIZ CIZ ,CTAD.IND_HISTORICO_CENTRAL FROM DIT_SOLICITUD S, DIT_TRAMITE T, DIT_CORRECCION_DATOS_ASEG DA, DIT_DETALLE_NSS_CDA NSS, DIT_CORRECCION_CTA_IND_CDA CIC, DIT_CTA_IND_NSS_CDA CTAO, DIT_CTA_IND_NSS_CDA CTAD, DIC_DELEGACION DELE, DIT_MOV_ACLARACION_NSS_CDA MOVA WHERE S.CVE_ID_SOLICITUD=T.CVE_ID_SOLICITUD AND CTAO.CVE_DELEGACION_ORIGEN = DELE.CLAVE_DELEGACION AND T.CVE_ID_TRAMITE=DA.CVE_ID_TRAMITE AND DA.CVE_ID_CORRECCION_DATOS_ASEG=NSS.CVE_ID_CORRECCION_DATOS_ASEG and CIC.CVE_ID_CTA_IND_OPER_ORIGEN = CTAO.CVE_ID_CTA_IND and CIC.CVE_ID_CTA_IND_OPER_DESTINO = CTAD.CVE_ID_CTA_IND AND MOVA.CVE_ID_DETALLE_NSS_CDA = NSS.CVE_ID_DETALLE_NSS_CDA and MOVA.CVE_ID_MOV_ACLARACION_NSS = CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_ACLARACION_NSS --AND CTAO.CVE_ID_ORIGEN_PERIODO_CTA_IND =1 --AND CTAD.CVE_ID_ORIGEN_PERIODO_CTA_IND =2 AND S.CVE_ID_ESTADO_SOLICITUD = 5 AND S.CVE_ID_TIPO_SOLICITUD = 50 AND T.CVE_ID_ESTADO_TRAMITE in (75,37) AND T.CVE_ID_TIPO_TRAMITE =139 AND MOVA.CVE_ID_TIPO_TRAM_CORREC_NSS IN (3,5,6,7) AND mova.fec_registro_baja is null AND CIC.fec_registro_baja is null and cic.CVE_ID_CTA_IND_OPER_DESTINO is not null AND (CIC.CVE_ID_ESTADO_MOV_ENV_SINDO IS NULL OR CIC.CVE_ID_ESTADO_MOV_ENV_SINDO = 2) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT SOL2.CVE_ID_SOLICITUD FROM DIT_SOLICITUD SOL2 INNER JOIN DIT_TRAMITE TRAM ON SOL2.CVE_ID_SOLICITUD = TRAM.CVE_ID_SOLICITUD INNER JOIN DIT_CORRECCION_DATOS_ASEG DA ON DA.CVE_ID_TRAMITE = TRAM.CVE_ID_TRAMITE INNER JOIN DIT_DETALLE_NSS_CDA NSS ON DA.CVE_ID_CORRECCION_DATOS_ASEG = NSS.CVE_ID_CORRECCION_DATOS_ASEG INNER JOIN DIT_MOV_ACLARACION_NSS_CDA MOVA ON MOVA.CVE_ID_DETALLE_NSS_CDA = NSS.CVE_ID_DETALLE_NSS_CDA WHERE SOL2.CVE_ID_ESTADO_SOLICITUD = 5 AND S.CVE_ID_SOLICITUD = SOL2.CVE_ID_SOLICITUD AND TRAM.CVE_ID_TIPO_TRAMITE = 139 AND T.CVE_ID_ESTADO_TRAMITE in (75,37) AND ((MOVA.CVE_ID_TIPO_NSS_ACLARACION IN (1,2) OR MOVA.CVE_ID_TIPO_TRAM_CORREC_NSS IN(1,2,4)) or (MOVA.CVE_ID_TIPO_NSS_ACLARACION =5 and MOVA.CVE_ID_TIPO_TRAM_CORREC_NSS =8)) AND (MOVA.CVE_ID_ESTADO_MOV_ENV_SINDO IS NULL or MOVA.CVE_ID_ESTADO_MOV_ENV_SINDO != 3) AND NSS.CVE_ID_TIPO_NSS IN (1,2,3) AND mova.fec_registro_baja is null ) union SELECT LPAD(CIC.CVE_ID_CORRECCION_CTA_IND_CDA,22,'0')||'CDA' AS FOLSOL, LPAD(CTAO.CVE_DELEGACION_ORIGEN, 2,'0') AS DELEGORIG, SUBSTR(CTAO.CVE_REGISTRO_PATRONAL, 1,8) AS REGPATORIG, CTAO.CVE_MODALIDAD AS MODPATORIG, CASE WHEN CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_OPER_ORIGEN = 'I' THEN 'A' ELSE CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_OPER_ORIGEN END AS TIPOOPORIG, --CIC.CVE_ID_MOV_CORRECCION AS TIPOOPORIG, SUBSTR(CTAO.NSS,1,10) AS NSSORIG, SUBSTR(CTAO.NSS,11,1) AS DVNSSORIG, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_RECEPCION_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY') AS FERECMOVORIG, LPAD(CTAO.CVE_TIPO_INI_MOV, 2 ,'0') TIPMOVINIORIG, CTAO.CVE_INI_MOV AS ORIGMOVINIORIG, --'0' AS ORIGMOVINIORIG, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_INI_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY') FECMOVINIORIG, LPAD(TRIM(replace( to_char(CTAO.SALARIO_BASE, '999999D99'), '.', '')),6, '0') AS SALBASEORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_TIPO_SALARIO), '0') as TIPOSALORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_EVENTUAL),0) AS TIPOTRABORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_EXT_CONV_SUSP),0) AS EXTEMPORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_SUBR_SERVICIOS),0) AS SUBROGSERVORIG, LPAD(CTAO.CVE_TIPO_FIN_MOV, 2, '0') AS TIPOMOVFINORIG, CTAO.CVE_FIN_MOV AS ORIGMOVFINORIG, --NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_FIN_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY'), '00000000') AS FEMOVFINORIG, CASE WHEN NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_FIN_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY'), '00000000') = '31129999' THEN '00000000' ELSE NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CTAO.FEC_FIN_MOV,'dd/mm/yyyy'),'DDMMYYYY'), '00000000') END AS FEMOVFINORIG, NVL(TRIM(CTAO.CVE_JORNADA_SEMANAL),0) JORSEMORIG, CASE WHEN LPAD(CTAO.CVE_CONSEC_PERIODOS, 3, '0') is null THEN '000' else LPAD(CTAO.CVE_CONSEC_PERIODOS, 3, '0') end NUMCONSPERORIG, --LPAD(CTAO.CVE_CONSEC_PERIODOS, 3, '0') NUMCONSPERORIG, NVL(CTAO.CURP,' ') AS CURPORIG, /*seccion en blanco para movimientos de eliminacion y creacion sobre el mismo NSS */ LPAD(' ', 8, ' ') AS REGPATDEST, LPAD(' ', 2, ' ') AS MODPATDEST, LPAD(' ', 1, ' ') AS TIPOOPERDEST, LPAD(' ', 10, ' ') AS NSSDEST, LPAD(' ', 1, ' ') AS DVNSSDEST, LPAD(' ', 8 , ' ') AS FECRECEPMOVDEST, LPAD(' ', 2, ' ') AS TIPOMOVDEST, LPAD(' ', 1, ' ') AS ORIMOVINIDEST, LPAD(' ', 8, ' ') AS FECMOVINIDEST, LPAD(' ', 6, ' ') AS SALBASCOTDEST, LPAD(' ', 1, ' ') TIPOSALDEST, LPAD(' ', 1, ' ') AS TIPOTRABEVEDEST, LPAD('
